 Xbox recruits DJ Khaled as Dr. Xbox for doctor's note promotion
 Xbox has enlisted DJ Khaled as Dr. Xbox for a novelty doctor's note campaign. The promotion encourages a day off for gaming without explicitly naming GTA 6.
 Written by Eliza Crichton-Stuart Updated Nov 17, 2026 Reading time 2 min Topic News 01 What the Dr. Xbox note actually means Summary See more GAMES.GG stories on Google

 Advertisement Xbox teamed up with DJ Khaled on November 16, 2026, for a novelty doctor's note promotion ahead of Grand Theft Auto 6 's launch. The musician takes on the persona of Dr. Xbox , urging players to put work aside for a day and pick up a controller.
 The official Xbox announcement , written in Khaled's promotional voice, describes a big week for gaming without explicitly naming GTA 6. Its message focuses on playing Xbox generally, with Khaled presenting his pitch from the “sunny shores of tropical Miami.”
 What the Dr. Xbox note actually means
 Players are directed to DrXbox.com for a personalized novelty doctor's note. Khaled suggests putting it on the fridge, showing it to a boss, or sending it to a group chat, treating the document as something to share as part of the joke.
 Related guide · Grand Theft Auto 6 GTA 6 Guide: How to Refuel Cars 
 Learn Grand Theft Auto 6's previewed refueling steps, where EVs recharge, and why you should check a stolen car's fuel.
 Khaled's mock consultation lists twitchy thumbs, controller cramps, late-night gaming dreams, and excitement around new releases as its supposed symptoms. His prescribed remedy is a day at home playing Xbox, free from emails, meetings, and other interruptions.
 The character's credentials are part of the gag, too. Khaled refers to a degree from Xbox University, acknowledges that it is unofficial, and jokes that his medical qualifications may be questionable.
 Xbox closes the promotion with a disclaimer stating that the note is not real and that it is not responsible if your employer doesn't have a sense of humor. If you're planning a gaming day away from work, seek approval through your usual leave process.
